name: Terrarium
description: v1's Terrarium: 10000 particles of five kinds (two light neutral ones and heavy electrons, up and down quarks of mass 511, 3000, 6000 with charges -1, 2/3, -1/3) and random ±1 nuclear charge start in a disk of radius 1, burst out under Coulomb (k = 1) and live in a reflecting circle of radius 1e6, the size of v1's sine nuclear range, so every pair feels it. No gravity, as in v1; v1's massless kind gets mass 1 (its unit inertia).
